title_zh: 医院门诊 & 承包商安全管理（一）
title_en: Day1: Hospital Outpatient & Contractor Safety Management (I)

vocab.example_en: Please take the patient to the emergency room right away.
vocab.example_zh: 请立刻把病人送到急诊室。

vocab.example_en: Please wait in the outpatient lobby until your number is called.
vocab.example_zh: 请在门诊大厅等候叫号。

vocab.example_en: Please go to the inpatient lobby to complete admission procedures.
vocab.example_zh: 请前往住院登记大厅办理入院手续。

vocab.example_en: Please register at the internal medicine department on the second floor.
vocab.example_zh: 请到二楼内科挂号。

vocab.example_en: Please show your medical insurance card before registration.
vocab.example_zh: 挂号前请出示医保卡。

vocab.example_en: Your GP may refer you to a specialist for further examination.
vocab.example_zh: 全科医生可能会将你转诊给专科医生进一步检查。

vocab.example_en: Your primary care doctor will coordinate your overall treatment.
vocab.example_zh: 家庭全科医生会统筹你的整体治疗。

vocab.example_en: Take a fever-reducer if your temperature exceeds 38.5 degrees.
vocab.example_zh: 体温超过 38.5 度时请服用退烧药。

vocab.example_en: Shake the cough syrup well before use.
vocab.example_zh: 服用前请摇匀止咳糖浆。

vocab.example_en: Please come back for a follow-up check in one week.
vocab.example_zh: 请一周后回来复查。

vocab.example_en: Patients with chronic illnesses need regular follow-up checks.
vocab.example_zh: 慢性病患者需要定期复查。

vocab.example_en: A bacterial infection usually requires antibiotics.
vocab.example_zh: 细菌感染通常需要使用抗生素。

vocab.example_en: Rest and drink water if you catch a viral cold.
vocab.example_zh: 患病毒性感冒时要多休息、多喝水。

vocab.example_en: The nurse will check your pulse and blood pressure.
vocab.example_zh: 护士会检查你的脉搏和血压。

vocab.example_en: Adequate sleep helps boost your immunity.
vocab.example_zh: 充足睡眠有助于提升免疫力。

vocab.example_en: Please describe your symptoms in detail to the doctor.
vocab.example_zh: 请向医生详细描述你的症状。

vocab.example_en: Clean and dress the wound to prevent infection.
vocab.example_zh: 清洁伤口并包扎，防止感染。

vocab.example_en: Open wounds may develop infection if not treated properly.
vocab.example_zh: 伤口处理不当可能发生感染。

vocab.example_en: Most patients recover fully within two weeks.
vocab.example_zh: 大多数患者两周内可完全康复。

vocab.example_en: The doctor will prescribe medicine based on your symptoms.
vocab.example_zh: 医生会根据症状开药。

vocab.example_en: Don't jump to conclusions before all test results are in.
vocab.example_zh: 在所有检查结果出来前不要过早下定论。

vocab.example_en: Regular exercise and a balanced diet help boost immunity.
vocab.example_zh: 规律运动和均衡饮食有助于提升免疫力。

vocab.example_en: You can register an appointment online or at the front desk.
vocab.example_zh: 你可以在线上或前台挂号。

vocab.zh: 将病人转诊给专科医生
vocab.example_en: The GP may refer the patient to a specialist for further tests.
vocab.example_zh: 全科医生可将病人转诊给专科医生做进一步检查。

vocab.example_en: Please describe your discomfort to the doctor as clearly as possible.
vocab.example_zh: 请尽可能清晰地向医生描述你的不适。

vocab.zh: 你今天哪里不舒服？（诊所问诊专用）
vocab.example_en: What brings you in today? Let me know your main concern.
vocab.example_zh: 你今天哪里不舒服？请告诉我最主要的问题。

vocab.en: Wait for your number on the screen
vocab.example_en: Please wait for your number on the screen in the outpatient lobby.
vocab.example_zh: 请在门诊大厅屏幕等候叫号。

vocab.en: Drink plenty of water, get enough rest
vocab.example_en: Drink plenty of water, get enough rest, and you'll feel better soon.
vocab.example_zh: 多喝水、充分休息，你很快就会好转。

vocab.example_en: All contractors must complete pre-qualification before site access.
vocab.example_zh: 所有承包商入场前必须完成资格预审。

vocab.example_en: Subcontractors must follow the same E. H. S. standards as the prime contractor.
vocab.example_zh: 分包商必须遵守与主承包商相同的 E. H. S. 标准。

vocab.example_en: The office based team coordinates daily operations with the on-site crew.
vocab.example_zh: 驻场办公团队与现场作业队伍协调日常工作。

vocab.example_en: Facilities support services cover utilities, cleaning, and building maintenance.
vocab.example_zh: 厂务后勤服务涵盖水电气、清洁和楼宇维护。

vocab.example_en: Grounds maintenance crews must wear high-visibility vests at all times.
vocab.example_zh: 场地维护人员必须全程穿戴反光背心。

vocab.example_en: Landscaping work near power lines requires an electrical safety review.
vocab.example_zh: 靠近电力线的园林绿化作业需要电气安全评审。

vocab.example_en: Janitorial services staff receive training on chemical handling and slip prevention.
vocab.example_zh: 保洁服务人员接受化学品操作与防滑培训。

vocab.example_en: Pest control applicators must carry their certification on site.
vocab.example_zh: 虫害防治施药人员必须随身携带资质证书。

vocab.example_en: Waste management contractors must segregate hazardous waste at the source.
vocab.example_zh: 废弃物管理承包商必须从源头分类危险废物。

vocab.example_en: Renovation projects require a work permit and pre-task plan.
vocab.example_zh: 翻新工程需要办理作业许可证和作业前方案。

vocab.example_en: Equipment maintenance is scheduled monthly to keep critical systems reliable.
vocab.example_zh: 设备维保按月排期，确保关键系统可靠运行。

vocab.example_en: Construction projects follow a four-stage safety management cycle.
vocab.example_zh: 施工项目遵循四阶段安全管理周期。

vocab.example_en: E. H. S. stands for Environmental, Health and Safety.
vocab.example_zh: E. H. S. 代表环境、健康与安全。

vocab.example_en: Pre-qualification is required before any contractor can bid on the project.
vocab.example_zh: 任何承包商投标前必须先通过资格预审。

vocab.example_en: Fill in the Contractor Pre-qualification Form and attach all licenses.
vocab.example_zh: 填写承包商资格预审表，并附上所有许可证。

vocab.example_en: The bid package must include pricing, schedule, and E. H. S. capability.
vocab.example_zh: 投标文件必须包含价格、进度和 E. H. S. 能力说明。

vocab.example_en: Both parties must sign the safety agreement before work begins.
vocab.example_zh: 双方必须在开工前签署安全协议。

vocab.zh: 承包商 E. H. S. 手册
vocab.example_en: The Contractor E. H. S. Manual is updated every year.
vocab.example_zh: 承包商 E. H. S. 手册每年更新一次。

vocab.example_en: A work permit is required for any hot work above 2 meters.
vocab.example_zh: 2 米以上的高处动火作业需要办理作业许可证。

vocab.example_en: Incident reporting and investigation must be completed within 24 hours.
vocab.example_zh: 事故上报与调查必须在 24 小时内完成。

vocab.example_en: Review the emergency response procedure before entering the site.
vocab.example_zh: 入场前必须学习应急处置流程。

vocab.example_en: Job Safety Analysis identifies hazards for each step of the task.
vocab.example_zh: 作业安全分析识别每一步作业的危险源。

vocab.example_en: Keep your safety training records ready for inspection at any time.
vocab.example_zh: 安全培训记录需随时备查。

vocab.example_en: Every new hire must complete safety orientation on the first day.
vocab.example_zh: 每位新员工入职第一天必须完成安全入职培训。

vocab.example_en: Web-based orientation training modules cover E. H. S. and code of conduct.
vocab.example_zh: 线上入职培训模块涵盖 E. H. S. 和行为准则。

vocab.example_en: Every contractor is subject to an annual audit by the E. H. S. team.
vocab.example_zh: 每家承包商每年接受一次 E. H. S. 团队的年度审核。

vocab.example_en: The quarterly performance review covers safety, quality, and schedule.
vocab.example_zh: 季度绩效评审涵盖安全、质量和进度。

vocab.example_en: Safety inspections are conducted weekly on high-risk work areas.
vocab.example_zh: 高风险作业区域每周开展安全检查。

vocab.example_en: Periodical safety meetings review lessons learned from the past month.
vocab.example_zh: 定期安全会议回顾过去一个月的经验教训。

vocab.example_en: Any reportable injury must be filed within 8 hours.
vocab.example_zh: 任何可记录工伤必须在 8 小时内上报。

vocab.example_en: Repeated safety citations may lead to suspension of site access.
vocab.example_zh: 多次安全违规处罚可能导致入场权限被暂停。

vocab.example_en: Verify that licences and certification are valid before starting work.
vocab.example_zh: 开工前需核验许可证与资质证书的有效性。

vocab.example_en: Each crew must designate a safety representative for the shift.
vocab.example_zh: 每个班组每个班次必须指定一名现场安全负责人。

vocab.example_en: Stage one is Pre-Qualification and Selection of qualified contractors.
vocab.example_zh: 第一阶段是资格预审与合格承包商筛选。

vocab.example_en: Pre-Job Safety covers orientation, training, and E. H. S. manual review.
vocab.example_zh: 入场安全准备涵盖入职、培训和 E. H. S. 手册学习。

vocab.example_en: On the Job Safety includes daily toolbox talks and permit checks.
vocab.example_zh: 现场作业安全包括每日班前会和许可证核查。

vocab.zh: 阶段4：作业后安全与绩效评估
vocab.example_en: Post-Job Safety reviews incident trends and lessons learned.
vocab.example_zh: 作业后安全与绩效评估复盘事故趋势与经验教训。

vocab.example_en: Hard hats are a mandatory requirement on all construction sites.
vocab.example_zh: 安全帽是所有施工现场的强制要求。

vocab.example_en: Please submit documents for pre-qualification two weeks before bid day.
vocab.example_zh: 请在投标日前两周提交资格预审文件。

vocab.example_en: Hazard identification is the first step of every risk assessment.
vocab.example_zh: 危险源辨识是每项风险评估的第一步。

vocab.example_en: Risk assessment determines what controls are needed for the task.
vocab.example_zh: 风险评估确定作业所需的管控措施。

vocab.example_en: Submit your work safety plan to the E. H. S. team for approval.
vocab.example_zh: 将作业安全方案提交给 E. H. S. 团队审批。

vocab.example_en: Both parties must sign off an agreement before mobilization.
vocab.example_zh: 双方必须在进场前签署协议。

vocab.en: prior to the commence of work
vocab.example_en: All training must be completed prior to the commence of work.
vocab.example_zh: 所有培训必须在开工之前完成。

vocab.example_en: Permits help control hazardous activities on the site.
vocab.example_zh: 许可证有助于管控现场的危险作业。

vocab.example_en: All contractors must comply with regulations of the host country.
vocab.example_zh: 所有承包商必须遵守东道国的法规。

vocab.example_en: The safety officer will verify training records before site access.
vocab.example_zh: 入场前安全员会核验培训记录。

vocab.example_en: All crew members must familiarize themselves with local standards.
vocab.example_zh: 所有班组成员必须熟悉本地标准。

vocab.example_en: We integrate safety management into project planning from day one.
vocab.example_zh: 我们从项目规划第一天起就把安全管理融入其中。

vocab.example_en: Each new hire must complete the designated online training modules.
vocab.example_zh: 每位新员工必须完成指定的线上培训模块。

vocab.example_en: Comply with central, provincial and local regulations at all times.
vocab.example_zh: 始终遵守国家、省、地方法规。

vocab.example_en: Electrical safety standards must be followed for live work.
vocab.example_zh: 带电作业必须遵守电气安全标准。

vocab.example_en: The inspector will cite any contractor who violates the E. H. S. rules.
vocab.example_zh: 检查员会对违反 E. H. S. 规定的承包商开具处罚。

vocab.example_en: Three citations in a quarter will trigger a performance review.
vocab.example_zh: 一个季度内三次违规处罚将触发绩效评审。

vocab.example_en: Designate one safety representative for each work crew.
vocab.example_zh: 为每个作业班组指派一名安全代表。

vocab.example_en: Distribute the E. H. S. manual to all crew members before entry.
vocab.example_zh: 入场前将 E. H. S. 手册发放给所有班组成员。

vocab.example_en: The E. H. S. team will conduct inspections on a weekly basis.
vocab.example_zh: E. H. S. 团队将每周开展检查。

vocab.example_en: Verify that all licenses are valid before mobilization.
vocab.example_zh: 进场前核验所有许可证的有效性。

vocab.example_en: Workers must identify hazards before starting any new task.
vocab.example_zh: 工人必须在开始任何新作业前识别危险源。

vocab.example_en: Evaluate risks before selecting controls for the task.
vocab.example_zh: 选择管控措施前先评估风险。
